system.model: Ollama local model via MODEL_NAME; developed to run with gemma3:4b, with a deterministic safe fallback when Ollama is unavailable
system.rule_handled: computed by R1 from the rule-path count; injection, phishing/security and obvious-noise rules run before the agent reasoner
system.preference_demo: m015: CC Priya on Hartwell & Cho legal mail; applied to later legal messages such as m018

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Routes every message through a rule-first router and gives every message exactly one disposition and reason; unresolved messages go to the agent reasoner.
capabilities.observable: Prints messages processed, disposition counts, rule/model paths, never-required-a-model count, and undecided: 0; writes decisions.json.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a response to a message that requires earlier thread context and records the source message ids actually read.
capabilities.observable: Prints a draft for m008 grounded in m003 and prints cited: [m003]. If no earlier source exists, drafts nothing.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl read and draft events; source messages in inbox.json

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Send and delete are never performed silently; dry-run suppresses them and normal mode requests per-action approval.
capabilities.observable: Shows the proposed send and delete actions and states that dry-run suppresses outbox writes.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Stores the explicit legal-mail CC preference from m015 and applies it after a later process restart.
capabilities.observable: First run writes prefs.json; a later run loads it and applies CC to later Hartwell & Cho/legal messages.

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects assistant-directed instructions inside email content, refuses them, logs the attempted action, tells the user, and leaves the hostile message untouched.
capabilities.observable: Flags m017, m024 and m039 (and any matching message), reports what was attempted, and performs no hostile action.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl refusal events and unchanged inbox.json/outbox/

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Builds exactly three panes: Pending Actions, Flagged, and Commitments; commitments cite source ids and conflicts are surfaced.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.json and dashboard.html with the three panes, a multi-message board-deck commitment from m038+m040, and scheduling conflicts.

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Walks sent-message threads, identifies owner messages without a later reply, and drafts a chase for each candidate.
capabilities.observable: Prints a JSON list containing message_id, days_waiting and draft.
capabilities.evidence: terminal output and trace.jsonl followups event

capabilities.name: Morning digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a one-screen summary of what needs attention, what can wait, and the count of auto-archived mail.
capabilities.observable: Prints NEEDS YOU, CAN WAIT and AUTO-ARCHIVED sections.
capabilities.evidence: terminal output and trace.jsonl digest event
